visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair, wearing a black short-sleeved t-shirt and dark grey trousers, stands in profile against a minimalist white wall. The wall is illuminated with soft pink and white spotlights and features bold black Chinese calligraphy and English text that reads "BEYOND THE ORDINARY." He gestures towards the text with his right hand, looking up with a curious and inviting expression. (2) The scene shifts to a spacious, modern exhibition hall where the man is crouching down to eye-level with a young girl sitting in a red wheelchair. The girl wears a pink shirt and colorful striped leggings, interacting with a tablet-sized eye-tracking device. A woman in a white branded t-shirt stands behind her. Above them, numerous large, clear glass or plastic spheres hang from the ceiling, creating a dreamlike atmosphere. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the digital screen of the eye-tracking device, showing a selfie of the man and the girl. The man is smiling widely and making a peace sign with his hand. The interface shows various software icons, a camera shutter button, and settings menus. (4) The man walks through another part of the exhibition, characterized by white walls decorated with vibrant, colorful circular graphics and informative text panels. He walks slowly with his hands clasped behind his back, observing the displays with a thoughtful and respectful gaze. The lighting is bright and professional, highlighting the educational posters on the walls. (5) The man interacts with a row of clear gashapon machines. He turns the silver handle of one machine, and a purple plastic capsule rolls down into the dispenser. He picks it up and opens it, showing a small white paper slip inside. In a subsequent shot, he uses a red marker to write on a yellow square post-it note and sticks it onto a wall covered in hundreds of other colorful notes. (6) The final shot is a medium group shot of the man, the girl in the wheelchair, and the woman. They are standing in front of the wall covered in colorful post-it notes and waving goodbye to the camera with cheerful, bright smiles. The man holds a purple gashapon ball, and the girl looks directly at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a calm and soothing male voice providing narration in Mandarin Chinese. His tone is warm, inviting, and professional. Accompanying his voice is a gentle, melodic piano background track with a moderate tempo and soft articulation, creating an atmosphere of sincerity and warmth. The overall audio quality is studio-clean with no background noise. (2) A sharp 'click' sound effect, mimicking a camera shutter, triggers this phase as the man and the girl take a selfie. Immediately following this, a high-pitched, synthesized female voice—produced by the eye-tracking device—asks a question. The man responds in a natural, conversational tone that is slightly lower in volume than his narration, but still very clear and friendly. (3) As the narration continues to explain the charity event, a distinct mechanical 'click-clack' sound is heard as the gashapon machine's handle is turned, followed by the soft 'thud' of a plastic capsule dropping into the plastic collection tray. The piano BGM persists throughout, maintaining its gentle rhythm and emotional major-key tonality under the main vocal track. (4) The narrator's voice becomes more enthusiastic and persuasive as he delivers the final call to action. The sound of a marker squeaking against paper can be faintly heard as a post-it note is written on. The background music swells slightly in volume, providing a conclusive emotional lift before both the speech and the piano melody gently fade out together.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a non-profit exhibition named 'Beyond the Ordinary' by MU-MU Non-profit, highlighting their eye-tracking technology for the disabled while cross-promoting KAIBEAUTY through interactive charity activities.
